closing.summary: Big strengths are fibre, practical staple carb source, and quite filling, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals, digestion, and energy and endurance sports because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, fibre supports digestion and steadier meals, and the carb section gives usable fuel.
